scope: Native subagent context maintenance: visible commands and controls, live unified thresholds, isolated self-compaction, cold/fork history support and narrow input toolbar layout.

desktop.modelBackend: deterministic local LlmAdapter registered in the real Desktop host
casesPassed: native parent and actual cold subagent coexist with independent input seats
typing slash in the real child composer exposes the compact command
manual button reads the cold child status and commits only its history
typed /compact runs the child action rather than sending a prompt
the real child automatically compacts on the next request at 97 percent using the shared threshold
a real child model request calls compact_context and continues after a formal receipt
the native child dialog saves the global threshold and the next child request uses it
the original native input bar keeps the child manual button when Codinput is disabled
Narrow native input toolbar wraps with zero overlapping controls

security.scope: npm dependency audit; no dependencies changed in R40

limitations: No user cloud provider/gateway generation was called. Remote network, billing/quota behavior and generated-summary quality were not assessed.

The visible Desktop scenarios use a native spawn child and a deterministic local 1M summarizer. Cold fork inheritance is separately exercised with the official Session implementation in regression tests.
Only synthetic profiles and archives were created/maintained; no user DSH process was restarted and no user session/profile was copied or modified.
validationTriage: Earlier failed source/fixture/desktop attempts are retained in local evidence. Fixture catalog metadata and GUI click/wait handling were corrected before final success.
The final native composer check uses a visible native Desktop window, real pointer input, and waits for the durable compaction receipt.
